Founder of House of Cauliman. Builder of XRPL culture, public proof systems, and permanent digital infrastructure.
AUGUR is a read-only Chain Oracle. It reads public wallets and turns them into plain-English intelligence. No keys. No custody. No wallet connection.
NEB is Network Edge Bot. A future XRPL trading console focused on spread capture, routing, and market-edge automation.
Continental Wick brings collector-grade XRPL art, culture, and protocol experiments into the House ecosystem.
$BAG is skill league money. Real games, real competition, real outcomes on XRPL rails.
HOMEEZ is the Capsule Toy Universe. Collectible character culture built inside the House of Cauliman ecosystem.
$RAD is a character-driven XRPL community token with ledger-aware utility, attitude, and public receipts.
NFTITANS is a House collection built around titan-scale characters, locked visual identity, and XRPL-native collectibles.
LAV is Legacy Access Vault. XRP-native, built for all chains, designed to help families find critical crypto access instructions when they need them.
XRPL LAYMAN is the plain-English XRPL education layer inside House of Cauliman.
Ledger Drop XRPL is a House of Cauliman gallery and drop layer for XRPL-native releases.
